subject: BenefitFlow beta publication closure recorded
body: Publication closure: the BenefitFlow beta v0.3.0 project core is live in boberino93-bit/benefitflow. Baseline commit is 3aeb7b8cd955e7435039e8d3e2ea04f66d68bd64; repository-binding/forum metadata checkpoint is f98e40c4b5a26ac70d098e730ee464b665500547. The project-specific repo contains the isolated AgentBus, beta code, tests, and recursive recovery utilities. The generic organization-mesh reference remains in the downloadable package rather than being treated as BenefitFlow-owned project code. R&D remains blocked pending explicit user start.
